nodes.label: Graceful Degradation Strategy
nodes.rationale: MediaPipe unavailable -> first-frame extraction; ElevenLabs failure -> gTTS fallback; agent tool errors are reported inside the response while the agent continues.

nodes.label: OpenCV Handwriting Preprocessing Pipeline (CLAHE, Adaptive Thresholding, EXIF)
nodes.norm_label: opencv handwriting preprocessing pipeline (clahe, adaptive thresholding, exif)
nodes.rationale: A light CV pass normalizes EXIF orientation and resizes for Bodhan IndicOCR; if an invalid character (e.g. shadow artifact) is recognized, a heavy CLAHE + Gaussian adaptive thresholding pass suppresses notebook lines and shadows before re-running OCR, keeping handwriting feedback deterministic.

nodes.label: Ammachi AI Language Learning Platform
nodes.rationale: Production PWA designed to help NRI children learn, retain, and celebrate Indian native languages (Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam, Kannada) by combining warm motherly AI mentorship with vision, speech, and agentic workflows.

nodes.label: Progressive Web App (Installable, Offline Shell)
nodes.rationale: Service Worker + Workbox static asset caching keeps the app shell, fonts, and cached lessons functional offline; installable on desktop and mobile.

nodes.label: Language-Based Dynamic Persona Prompt
nodes.rationale: Persona adapts to the selected language (Tamil -> Ammachi Tanglish, Hindi -> Dadi Hinglish, other -> Grandma English) so cultural learning feels native.

nodes.label: Ammachi Persona in Error Messages
nodes.rationale: Error messages use the grandmother persona ('Aiyayo!', 'My ears are not working properly') to maintain the experience even during failures.

nodes.label: Microservices Architecture
nodes.rationale: Allows modular development and deployment of backend components.

nodes.label: Patience Agent (LLM Stutter Cleaning)
nodes.rationale: Key accessibility feature for children with speech difficulties: removes stuttered repeats, filler words, and fixes phonetic misinterpretations before the reply is generated.

nodes.label: AI Voice Agent (STT + Patience Denoising + TTS)
nodes.norm_label: ai voice agent (stt + patience denoising + tts)

nodes.label: Recasting (Gentle Grammar Correction)
nodes.rationale: Subtly corrects grammar by repeating the sentence correctly inside the warm reply instead of scolding the child.

nodes.label: Local-First SQLite Database (ammachi.db)
nodes.rationale: SQLite chosen for simplicity and zero-config deployment; the database file is auto-created alongside the application, and stamps persist as a JSON-serialized list deserialized with json.loads on read.

nodes.label: Wide-Open CORS Middleware Policy
nodes.rationale: allow_origins='*' allows the Streamlit frontend and any other client to communicate without cross-origin restrictions; wide-open for development, should be restricted in production.

nodes.label: JWT Authentication (HS256, 7-Day Expiry)
nodes.rationale: Stateless tokens returned to the client on login; JWT_SECRET env var with default fallback, 7-day expiry, HS256.

nodes.label: No Hardcoded Secrets (Env-Managed Configuration)
nodes.rationale: All API keys, database credentials, and JWT secrets are managed via environment variables instead of source code.

nodes.label: Strict CORS Policy (FRONTEND_URL / CORS_ORIGINS)
nodes.rationale: Origins are strictly controlled to protect user privacy and progress integrity.
